ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory pre-incorporation and ongoing screening under the AML/CFT Act No. 15 of 2020 and VFSC guidance: (i) identity verification of all directors, shareholders, and UBOs from independent and reliable sources; (ii) Politically Exposed Persons identification covering foreign and domestic PEPs, family members, and close associates; (iii) sanctions screening against the UN Security Council Consolidated List, OFAC SDN List, EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, and domestic measures under the Sanctions Act No. 14 of 2017; (iv) adverse-media, enforcement, insolvency, and regulatory discipline-database checks; and (v) source-of-wealth and source-of-funds verification. Any definitive sanctions match is an absolute disqualifier; any PEP or enhanced-risk match requires written approval of the registered agent's designated compliance officer, enhanced due diligence, and ongoing transaction monitoring.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) - Companies Registry name-search and reservation system, accessed exclusively through VFSC-licensed registered agents (no direct public self-service filing)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Official languages of Vanuatu are Bislama, English, and French; all corporate names must be inscribed in Latin script. The name must end with a permitted corporate identifier, e.g., LIMITED, CORPORATION, INCORPORATED, SOCIETE ANONYME or the abbreviations LTD, CORP., INC., S.A., and must be in English or French (Bislama-only names are not accepted). Non-Latin-script names (e.g., Cyrillic, CJK, Arabic) are not registrable and must be transliterated into a Latin-script English or French rendering. The name must not be identical or confusingly similar to any name already on the VFSC register and must not misstate the company's activities as to the sulfur mineral ore trading and dry-bulk brokerage scope.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Bank (requires VFSC consent and applicable licensing)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection, the applicant through its VFSC-licensed registered agent may file a written reconsideration request with the Registrar of International Companies within 14 calendar days of the rejection notice, attaching a statutory declaration and submissions distinguishing the proposed name from conflicting register entries. The Registrar must respond within 10 business days. A further refusal may be elevated by administrative review to the VFSC Board; thereafter, an aggrieved applicant may commence judicial review in the Supreme Court of Vanuatu within 30 days of the final administrative decision. In parallel, the applicant may immediately re-submit an alternative name under a fresh 30-day reservation.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permitted only as a remote operational posting: the International Company must maintain its statutory registered office at the physical Port Vila (or Luganville) address of a VFSC-licensed registered agent, where statutory records and the beneficial ownership register are held. The sulfur trading and dry-bulk brokerage business may be operated entirely remotely with no physical employees, premises, or assets in Vanuatu. A pure mail-forwarding virtual office does not satisfy the statutory registered-office requirement unless it is the licensed registered agent's supervised physical office.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low: estimated annual probability of an unannounced physical inspection of the IC's own operations is below 5% because the entity has no physical footprint in Vanuatu and holds no VFSC financial-services licence. However, VFSC conducts routine on-site and off-site compliance examinations of licensed registered agents, during which the IC's statutory records, UBO register, and AML/CFT files are subject to inspection at the registered agent's office on no notice.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act [CAP 222] of the Republic of Vanuatu, as amended, together with the International Companies Regulations; principal provisions govern incorporation, memorandum and articles, name reservation, registered office and registered agent, share capital issuance, and appointment of the first board of directors and officers.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), Companies Registry Division, Port Vila, Republic of Vanuatu.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Official Application for Incorporation of an International Company (Form IC-1), filed together with the executed Memorandum and Articles of Association.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital applies to an International Company under the International Companies Act [CAP 222]. The Company is formed with a single ordinary share of USD 1 par value subscribed by the sole shareholder. No escrow bank account or upfront capital deposit is mandated at incorporation; authorized capital may be increased by ordinary board resolution without notarization.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED THAT the Memorandum and Articles of Association of the Company, as registered with the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission, be and are hereby ratified and adopted in full. RESOLVED FURTHER THAT the allotment and issue of one ordinary share at par value to the sole subscriber be and is hereby approved, and the share register of the Company be opened accordingly. RESOLVED FURTHER THAT the registered office of the Company be established at the offices of the licensed registered agent in Port Vila, Republic of Vanuatu. RESOLVED FURTHER THAT [NAME] be appointed sole Director and [NAME] Corporate Secretary of the Company, each to hold office until the first annual general meeting.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Company Name Reservation and Prefix Clearance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), Companies Registry Division, Port Vila, acting through a licensed registered agent.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a formal name clearance letter to the VFSC Companies Registry requesting reservation of the proposed company name together with two alternate names. The Registry verifies that the proposed name is not identical or misleadingly similar to an existing registered entity and does not contain words prohibited without separate licensing (e.g., bank, trust, assurance, government or crown). Written name approval is issued to the licensed agent.
required_dossiers: Name reservation application letter with two alternate names
Certified copy of the passport of the sole beneficial owner
Utility bill or bank statement evidencing residential address (not older than three months)
Duly executed engagement letter appointing the licensed registered agent
KYC declaration of the sole shareholder
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the proposed name is refused, the registered agent files a fresh name reservation application with alternative names within three business days. Where refusal is grounded on resemblance to an existing entity, a consent letter from that entity may also be lodged to cure the conflict.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation and Execution of Memorandum and Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed registered agent in Port Vila; execution by the sole subscriber.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The registered agent drafts the Memorandum and Articles of Association in conformity with the International Companies Act [CAP 222], fixing the corporate name, the registered office at the agent's Port Vila address, the authorized share capital and share classes, the board's borrowing and contracting powers, and standard indemnity provisions. The sole subscriber executes the charter documents before the agent as witness; notarization is not required by Vanuatu law for International Companies.
required_dossiers: Draft Memorandum and Articles of Association (two originals)
Written consent of the proposed sole director to act
Written consent of the proposed corporate secretary to act
Certified KYC pack of the sole subscriber
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Any drafting deficiency identified by the agent or the VFSC is cured by re-execution of a conformed version of the charter prior to lodgment; pre-registration amendment requires only subscriber consent and attracts no additional state fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Lodgment of Application for Incorporation and Payment of State Fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), Companies Registry Division, Port Vila.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Lodge the completed official Form IC-1 together with two executed copies of the Memorandum and Articles of Association and pay the statutory incorporation fee of USD 250. The VFSC Companies Registry examines the application for statutory completeness and consistency of the corporate name, registered office, share capital, and subscriber details. Fees are settled by direct bank transfer or agent settlement with the receipt attached to the filing.
required_dossiers: Official Form IC-1 (Application for Incorporation of an International Company)
Two executed copies of the Memorandum and Articles of Association
Confirmation of payment of the VFSC state incorporation fee
Acceptance letter of the licensed registered agent
Certified KYC pack and economic substance declaration of the beneficial owner
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the VFSC issues an inquiry or defect notice, the registered agent and counsel cure the stated defects and resubmit the application within fourteen days. Where the first filing is administratively rejected, a fresh Form IC-1 is executed and re-lodged with corrected particulars at no additional fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), Companies Registry Division.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon statutory clearance, the VFSC registers the International Company and issues the Certificate of Incorporation together with an extract of registered particulars. The registered agent verifies the name, date of incorporation, registered office, and authorized share capital shown on the certificate against the filed charter instruments.
required_dossiers: No additional dossiers are required; issuance relies on the approved Form IC-1 and filed Memorandum and Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Where the Certificate of Incorporation contains clerical or typographical errors, a corrected certificate is obtained from the VFCS registry correction procedure. Substantive mismatches of name, capital, or office are cured by filing an amendment to the charter and a corresponding registry update.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Activation of Statutory Registered Office and Corporate Registers
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed registered agent in Port Vila, Republic of Vanuatu.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Activate the statutory registered office at the licensed agent's registered address; open the statutory registers of members, directors, secretary, and charges; keep the common seal and original charter documents at the registered office; and complete the first-year VFSC annual fee payment. The registered agent acts as the official point of service for regulatory correspondence and annual return filings.
required_dossiers: Registered agent services agreement
Payment confirmation of the first-year VFSC annual retention fee
Corporate register ledgers in the prescribed statutory format
Written resolution of the sole subscriber appointing the registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registered agent declines to continue service or the registered office address is otherwise relinquished, the board passes a resolution appointing a substitute licensed agent and files the change of registered office and agent with the VFSC within seven days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: First Board Meeting and Appointment of Officers
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Board of Directors of the Company.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene the first board meeting, or execute a unanimous written board resolution, adopting the pro-forma First Board Resolution: ratification of the charter, approval of the allotment of one ordinary share to the sole subscriber, establishment of the registered office at the licensed agent's premises, and appointment of the sole Director and Corporate Secretary. Issue the share certificate and place written consents to act in the statutory registers.
required_dossiers: Pro-forma First Board Resolution (as set out in the incorporation_legal_framework)
Written consents to act of the sole Director and Corporate Secretary
Share certificate for the sole subscriber evidencing one ordinary share
Statutory register of members, directors, and secretary
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a defect in the appointment or share allotment is later detected, the board rescinds the affected resolution and passes a corrective resolution; officer or allotment particulars are updated with the VFSC without penalty where corrected within thirty days.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not engaged for the registered offshore activity. The Company performs title-trading and voyage-brokerage of granular elemental sulfur with no physical premises, storage, or handling operations in Vanuatu. If a domestic physical presence is later established, the Department of Industry within the Ministry of Tourism, Trade, Commerce and Ni-Vanuatu Business, together with the relevant Municipal Council, would be the competent licensing bodies.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: None required for the ISIC 4669 offshore dry-bulk trading and brokerage business as conducted by a non-resident International Company. A municipal business license under the Municipalities Act [CAP 126] would be engaged only upon establishing a physical office or warehouse in Vanuatu; no industrial manufacturing or mineral processing permit applies.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Department of Environmental Protection and Conservation (DEPC), Ministry of Climate Change Adaptation, Meteorology, Geo-Hazards, Environment, Energy and Disaster Management, Port Vila, Republic of Vanuatu.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt — no EIA registration, screening, or full EIA report is triggered for the registered pure trading and brokerage activity, which has no physical footprint, discharge point, or emission source on Vanuatu territory. A comprehensive EIA would be required only if the Company later establishes onshore sulfur storage, blending, or harbor transshipment facilities in Vanuatu, in accordance with the Environmental Management and Conservation Act and its EIA Regulations.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No wastewater, VOC, or waste-handling thresholds are engaged for the registered offshore trading model. Should physical handling of granular sulfur be established in Vanuatu, compliance would be required with: (i) Vanuatu national wastewater discharge standards for any wash-water or run-off; (ii) fugitive dust and sulfur dioxide atmospheric emission benchmarks, including occupational exposure below the ACGIH TLV-TWA of 0.5 ppm; (iii) the International Maritime Solid Bulk Cargoes (IMSBC) Code Group B handling and ventilation requirements; and (iv) the Vanuatu National Waste Management Regulations for handling residues and packaging waste.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Not required for a non-resident trading entity with no physical premises, fire risk, or workforce in Vanuatu. Should the Company later open a Port Vila office or an Efate warehousing facility, it would be required to obtain: (i) an annual fire safety certificate from the Vanuatu Fire and Emergency Services; (ii) a structural load clearance from the Department of Public Works for any racked or bulk storage; and (iii) a workplace occupancy clearance from the Port Vila Municipal Council under the Municipalities Act [CAP 126].

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Department of Finance & Treasury - Inland Revenue Division (Vanuatu Customs & Inland Revenue Service), Ministry of Finance and Economic Management, Port Vila; corporate and international-company registry administered by the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC); official government portal maintained under the gov.vu domain.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Step 1: Engage a VFSC-licensed registered agent to incorporate the International Company under the International Companies Act [Cap. 222]; VFSC issues the Certificate of Incorporation containing the statutory company registration number, which is the definitive corporate identity. Step 2: No mandatory direct-tax TIN is issued because the International Company is statutorily exempt from income tax and corporate tax; the entity may optionally obtain an identification certificate from the Inland Revenue Division for banking, LC and KYC purposes. Step 3: Register with the Vanuatu Customs & Inland Revenue Service via the ASYCUDA World electronic single window only if the IC imports dutiable goods into Vanuatu or supplies enumerated prescribed services subject to the 4% Service Tax. Step 4: A Port Vila or Luganville municipal business license is required only if the IC maintains a physical local place of business, which is not required for offshore dry-bulk sulfur brokerage conducted by a non-resident International Company.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: None domestically. The International Company exemption from income tax, corporate tax, dividend distribution tax, capital gains tax and withholding tax is automatic and non-elective under Section 3 of the International Companies Act [Cap. 222]. Vanuatu has no check-the-box, CFC, hybrid-mismatch, fiscal-transparency or minimum-tax election. Foreign tax classifications (e.g., a US check-the-box election) are irrelevant for Vanuatu direct-tax purposes and cannot alter the statutory exemption; no GAAR or anti-deferral election is available.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: No VAT/GST in force. The 12.5% Value Added Tax (VAT Act No. 8 of 2014) was repealed effective 1 July 2018. Residual consumption taxes are the 4% Service Tax [Cap. 80] on enumerated prescribed services (hotel/tourism accommodation, restaurants, car rental, telecommunications and certain insurance-related or port-type services) and customs import/export duties; none of these applies to FOB/CFR/CIF wholesale trading of granular elemental sulfur mineral ore.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Not applicable: no VAT/GST registration threshold exists in VUV because the VAT system was repealed on 1 July 2018. Under the residual Service Tax [Cap. 80], any person supplying an enumerated prescribed service must register for the 4% Service Tax irrespective of turnover; customs registration is transaction-driven per import/export. A Vanuatu International Company engaged purely in offshore marine sulfur brokerage outside the enumerated prescribed services has no indirect-tax registration obligation.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No national real-time e-invoicing, fiscal clearance, continuous-transaction-control (CTC), API stamping or digital fiscal-stamp mandate exists in Vanuatu. Paper invoices and ordinary commercial records are legally sufficient. The only electronic clearance interface is the ASYCUDA World customs single window, through which import/export declarations must be filed electronically for physical cargo movements; no real-time digital stamping is required.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Not applicable. Vanuatu has had no VAT/GST since 1 July 2018, so there is no export zero-rating claim, no output VAT on exported goods and no input-VAT refund mechanism. Under the erstwhile 12.5% VAT (2015-2018), exported goods could be zero-rated with documentary proof; that regime is spent. Exports of sulfur mineral ore from Vanuatu waters or transshipped cargo are presently outside Vanuatu consumption tax entirely, provided the IC supplies no Vanuatu prescribed service. Genuine export documentation remains necessary for Vanuatu customs compliance and for the buyer's or destination-jurisdiction's export VAT/GST relief.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (ASYCUDA World electronic entry) showing HS 2503 classification for sulfur of any kind other than sublimed, precipitated or colloidal sulfur
Bill of Lading (or FI/FO charter-party fixture note) evidencing shipment on a dry-bulk vessel from a Vanuatu port or transshipment point
Inward Remittance Certificate (bank FX settlement statement) evidencing receipt of export proceeds
Commercial invoice stating exporter IC, buyer, INCOTERMS, price, weight, quantity and sulfur grade
Certificate of Origin (non-preferential or PACER-plus / Melanesian Spearhead Group preferential certificate if claimed)
Prior import entry and terminal/warehouse receipt confirming ownership and storage where cargo passed through Vanuatu
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Vanuatu has no VAT/export-refund clawback regime because no VAT is in force. Compliance risk sits primarily under the Customs Act [Cap. 145]: false declarations, misdescription or undervaluation of sulfur exports attract forfeiture of goods, duty evaded plus up to double-duty penalty, fines up to VT 200,000 and imprisonment up to 3 years for knowingly false statements. The International Company's direct-tax exemption depends on the absence of Vanuatu-source income; sham pricing or shell-transaction structures could be disregarded by a court, and any future income-tax legislation may authorize retroactive assessment. Vanuatu has no reciprocal tax-collection agreement for foreign clawback orders, but customs records and VFSC beneficial-ownership data remain exchangeable under international tax-transparency commitments.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Reserve Bank of Vanuatu (RBV), acting as the monetary authority, financial supervisor, and exchange control administrator under the Reserve Bank Act [Cap. 125] and the Foreign Exchange Administration Act framework.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Vatu (VUV) is predominantly free-floating and fully convertible for both current account and capital account transactions. Vanuatu has accepted Article VIII obligations of the IMF, and there are no prior approval procedures or quantitative limits on inward or outward remittances relating to trade, financing, equity, or profit repatriation. Profit remittance hurdles are effectively nil for International Companies registered under the International Companies Act [Cap. 222]; nevertheless, licensed authorised dealers must record balance-of-payments purpose codes, and source-of-funds documentation will be required for any outward transfer of proceeds generated from sulphur mineral ore trade to ensure compliance with the Anti-Money Laundering and International Financial Transactions Act.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: There is no statutory surrender requirement, no mandatory conversion ratio, no prescribed timeline for repatriation, and no authorised-dealer exchange control exemption needed for export receipts arising from the dry bulk marine transport and brokerage of granular elemental sulphur. Exporters retain unfettered discretion to maintain, deploy, or convert foreign currency proceeds in onshore or offshore non-resident accounts. A Vanuatu International Company should nevertheless maintain a complete treasury archive comprising bills of lading, commercial invoices, certificates of origin, weighbridge or laboratory analysis attestations, and payment receipts, as supporting evidence in any future RBV or Financial Intelligence Unit audit or counterparty bank prospective due diligence review.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account and Trade Finance LC Facility

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility Rating: Low to Medium with material legal and practical constraints. Vanuatu does not maintain a dedicated electronic money institution (EMI) licensing category comparable to the EU Revised Payment Services Directive. VFSC-licensed money transmitters or payment service providers are limited and are mainly capped by local correspondent banking relationships; offshore digital EMIs without a physical branch or a VFSC payment-dealer licence are not permitted to clear or settle VUV or hold client-blocked accounts for a Vanuatu International Company. The only bankable alternative is a white-label payment and escrow arrangement delivered through an RBV-licensed authorised dealer (ANZ, BSP, or BRED), combined with SWIFT-based API connectivity and a separate client money deposit account.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: RBV regulatory guidance and prevailing bank de-risking practices require at least one natural-person director, UBO, or authorised signatory to appear in person at a Port Vila or Luganville branch for an in-person KYC interview before account activation of an International Company. Fully remote account opening is not available for a newly formed non-resident IC; however, a hybrid remote protocol is recognised where a licensed bank agent or a Vanuatu corporate service provider physically conducts identity verification, executes a sworn affidavit before a Commissioner of Oaths, and presents a notarised set of passports, Articles of Association, Certificate of Incorporation, and Registry Extract. Even with such a hybrid protocol, banks typically require a subsequent video conference with treasury or risk officers and the timely provision of a Board Resolution on the intended treasury and FX hedging mandate.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Cross-border transactions involving jurisdictions appearing on FATF, FIU, or national sanctions lists, including end-users or ship charterers linked to politically exposed or high-risk mineral brokers.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Full negative-media and sanctions screening results for all counterparties, vessel ISM registrations, Independent Shipping Assurance Attestation, lawful end-user certificates, and a complete transport chain dossier from the origin warehouse through marine loading, voyage, and discharge, together with the board-approved sanction compliance policy and internal mitigation register.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Discrepancy between the IC's low-risk trading description (ISIC 4669 mineral wholesale) and high-frequency, high-value disbursements exceeding USD 500,000 per month without evidence of physical commodity movement.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Charter party or ocean bill of lading evidencing loaded granular sulphur products, commercial invoices, packing lists, Certificate of Origin, Certificate of Analysis, fumigation certificate, marine insurance policy, signed loading-master tally sheets, and SWIFT mirror payments reference chain supporting each LC drawdown.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Use of an opaque corporate structure with nominee directors or a non-resident professional corporate-services provider, resulting in an inability of the bank to identify or contact all material UBOs in a timely manner.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Registered-agent declaration, full shareholder and ultimate beneficial ownership register reflecting all direct and indirect holdings of 10% or more, proof of the director's residential and professional address, notarised consent to suspend nominee authority, and a current International Company Search Report issued by the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Capital injection from the ultimate beneficial owner or the holding entity shall be routed exclusively by SWIFT MT103 single-customer credit transfer to the IC's designated operational or escrow account, or, for parent-to-subsidiary flows, by SWIFT MT202/MT202 COV for cover payment. Incoming remittances must be described in the treasury instruction as 'Equity Contribution' or 'Intercompany Loan Drawdown' and matched against a Board Resolution, Share Subscription Agreement, or signed Loan Agreement. The Vanuatu authorised dealer will record the inward transfer under the RBV-monitored balance-of-payments classification as direct investment (category 710) or loan liability (category 715). Cash wiring protocols prohibit bearer deposits, third-party first-party cheque deposits, and any unsupported same-day reversal or linked-party routing through unreviewed shell accounts. Evidence of documented trade intent and the original contract chain for sulphur procurement and resale must be furnished upon first funding to prevent transaction laundering allegations.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound disbursements for the purchase of dry bulk granular elemental sulphur and affiliated marine freight shall be effected through the following clearing rails: (i) clean SWIFT MT103 transfers under documentary collection (DP/DA) for routine supplier payments; (ii) irrevocable, conforming, cumulative weekly-use letters of credit issued under SWIFT MT700/MT701 with UCP 600 and eUCP 2.0 terms for high-value cargo shipments; (iii) direct negotiation and discounting of the seller's draft under MT750/MT760 advice when the seller requires cash payment before discharge; and (iv) commercial standby LCs issued in favour of charterers or freight forwarders for demurrage and fixture security. All outward remittances must be tied to a corresponding purchase invoice, pre-settlement marine logistics confirmation, and a certificate of customs-clearance at the destination port. The IC's treasury policy must prohibit the use of cash advances, hawala arrangements, or undisclosed crypto-backed correspondents; each payment must be prefunded in USD or AUD and cleared strictly through the RBV-licensed authorised bank.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Short-dated VUV/USD and VUV/AUD forward outrights written by ANZ, BSP, or BRED with a maximum tenor of 12 months, supported by a valid invoice, LC, or charter party cash-flow forecast.

USD-denominated structural natural hedging via multicurrency operating accounts where VUV receipts from incidental domestic sources are offset against USD import settlement obligations, thereby reducing the need for separate derivative transactions.
USD/VUV cross-currency swap executed through a licensed authorised dealer solely to match the IC's projected net working-capital deficit against the designated sulphur cargo purchase contract.

European-style vanilla FX call or put options with a premium cap and no knock-in or knock-out feature, permitted where the notional amount does not exceed 100% of the confirmed trade payable in the corresponding settlement currency.

Zero-cost collars (forward band structures) on USD/AUD for marine freight and bunker disbursements, provided the underlying exposure is a signed voyage charter or freight agreement with confirmed payment dates.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual International Company Licence Renewal (Annual Government Fee)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before the anniversary of incorporation in each calendar year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment incurs a 10% penalty per month; failure to pay for six consecutive months triggers administrative strike-off and consequent loss of corporate existence

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No compulsory audit thresholds apply. International Companies registered under the Vanuatu International Companies Act 1992 are statutorily exempt from independent audit and from the filing of audited financial statements.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: No statutory accounting framework is prescribed for an International Company. Voluntary financial statements, if prepared, are commonly presented in accordance with IFRS.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: No annual or periodic UBO confirmation is required to be filed with the VFSC for an International Company. Upon any transfer of shares, the transfer must be recorded in the register of members immediately, and the registered agent must update the beneficial ownership register at the registered office. The updated register is retained on-site and becomes subject to lawful VFSC inspection only.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: Not applicable (no statutory audit requirement); voluntary audit range USD 3,000 - 6,000

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% — Vanuatu levies no corporate income tax on International Companies under section 43 of the International Companies Act 1992.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Full statutory tax exemption: no income tax, no capital gains tax, no inheritance or gift tax, no stamp duty on share transfers, and no withholding tax on distributions paid to non-resident shareholders. An International Company may obtain a Certificate of Tax Exemption from the Commissioner of Inland Revenue to evidence its exempt status before banks, insurers, and counterparties. The only recurring fiscal costs are the VFSC annual licence fee and the registered agent's professional fee.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: VFSC Annual Return for International Companies (prescribed form 'IC Annual Return') lodged under section 42(1) of the International Companies Act 1992 and the International Companies Regulations through the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) IC Registry portal or via the licensed registered agent in Port Vila. No income tax return is required because the corporation tax base is nil.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual, on each anniversary of incorporation.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: The annual return and annual licence fee are due on the anniversary of incorporation, with a statutory grace period not exceeding 60 days; default after the 60-day window triggers late penalties and strike-off proceedings.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Exact registered legal name, IC registration number, date of incorporation, registered office, and registered agent particulars.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Confirm that a Vanuatu-licensed registered agent is appointed and that the registered office is a physical address within Port Vila; offshore correspondence addresses are not acceptable and will be rejected.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Authorised share capital, number and class of issued shares, par value, and total consideration received for issued shares.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Bearer shares are prohibited; list exact issued shares attributable to non-resident shareholders; the share register and copies of share certificates must be physically maintained at the registered office in Vanuatu.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full legal names, residential addresses, nationality, and shareholding percentage of each director and each member.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident directors and shareholders are permitted; each director must nevertheless provide a service address in Vanuatu, and the registered agent must accept the beneficial ownership declaration on file.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Annual declaration of whether the company carried on a 'relevant activity' (distribution, shipping, holding, financing and leasing, intellectual property, banking, insurance, headquarters) and whether it is tax resident in a qualifying foreign jurisdiction.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A sulphur mineral ore trading and dry bulk marine brokerage IC must affirm whether it is tax resident in a jurisdiction outside the EU/OECD blacklist; if resident elsewhere, the foreign tax-residence certificate must be submitted to the VFSC registry.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Part E — Agent Certification and Fee Remittance (Box 12)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Certification by the registered agent that the return is true and complete, with remittance of the annual licence fee prescribed by the International Companies (Fees) Regulations (bracketed between approximately VUV 25,000 and VUV 530,000 based on authorised capital).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Fees are payable in Vanuatu Vatu or an approved United States dollar equivalent through the registered agent; the agent must certify that all non-resident principals have been subject to completed AML/CFT customer due diligence.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing surcharge of VUV 5,000 for the first month of default, increasing by VUV 2,500 per month up to a statutory cap of VUV 250,000; non-payment of the annual licence fee for one year results in strike-off and dissolution after restoration proceedings; restoration is discretionary and carries a fee of approximately VUV 100,000 in addition to all outstanding arrears.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% — Vanuatu imposes no dividend withholding tax; International Company dividends may be paid to non-resident shareholders free of any domestic tax, capital duty, or stamp duty.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: No comprehensive double taxation agreements (DTAs) are in force for Vanuatu; the country maintains only Tax Information Exchange Agreements (TIEAs) with jurisdictions such as Australia and New Zealand. Because there is no Vanuatu tax to relieve, no formal treaty relief application or Tax Residence Certificate submission is legally required. For foreign bank or confirming-house attestation, the beneficial owner should obtain a Certificate of Tax Exemption from the Commissioner of Inland Revenue confirming the 0% domestic rate on the distribution.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory withholding tax: 0% on debt interest and 0% on intellectual property royalties paid to non-residents; treaty withholding under the TIEA framework: 0% (TIEAs provide administrative exchange only and grant no reduced withholding rates).

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: No statutory transfer pricing threshold exists because Vanuatu has no corporate income tax. However, under the Vanuatu Economic Substance Rules introduced by the International Companies (Amendment) Act 2021, an International Company engaged in controlled transactions with connected non-residents should maintain intercompany pricing records aligned with the OECD Transfer Pricing Guidelines whenever substance is claimed in Vanuatu; practical substance-file preparation is expected where gross annual revenue exceeds VUV 20,000,000.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: The Vanuatu Economic Substance Rules mirror the BVI/Caribbean ESR model: every International Company carrying on a relevant activity, unless tax resident in a qualifying foreign jurisdiction, must demonstrate (i) direction and management exercised in Vanuatu; (ii) core income-generating activities performed in Vanuatu; (iii) adequate employees, premises, and expenditure proportionate to the activity. ISIC 4669 wholesale trading of granular elemental sulphur may qualify as 'distribution', and dry bulk marine transport brokerage may qualify as 'shipping'; both are listed relevant activities subject to the mandatory annual VESR declaration and VFSC review.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax offence — fraudulent tax-exemption certificate and evasion of VAT and customs duty
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the International Company tax-exemption certificate to avoid the 12.5% Vanuatu VAT and customs duty on sulphur cargoes actually landed for local consumption, or making a false declaration that physical cargo never enters Vanuatu customs territory while arranging domestic delivery through Vanuatu ports.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Administrative penalty of up to three times the evaded VAT or customs duty plus a civil fine of up to VUV 2,000,000 under the Value Added Tax Act 2021 and the Customs Act 2013; criminal conviction for making false statements to the Commissioner of Inland Revenue.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors to whom the evasion is attributed are personally liable for the evaded amount; criminal conviction carries imprisonment of up to 2 years; foreign directors are exposed to extradition under Vanuatu's mutual assistance and extradition arrangements.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell company operation and economic substance violation
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating a substance-less International Company executing high-volume sulphur trade flows and SWIFT / Letter-of-Credit payment rails solely from a Port Vila mailbox without any local direction and management, employees, premises, or accounting records, and failing to file the annual Vanuatu Economic Substance declaration.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Monetary penalty of up to VUV 5,000,000; mandatory reporting and automatic exchange of information with EU and OECD jurisdictions; strike-off of the company from the VFSC registry with frozen assets pending restoration.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors are jointly and severally liable for unpaid economic substance penalties; a director who signs a false economic substance declaration is subject to disqualification orders, travel restraints, and imprisonment of up to 2 years.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Anti-Money Laundering / counter-financing-of-terrorism failure associated with LC payment rails
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to maintain an AML/CFT compliance programme, omission of customer due diligence on the final beneficial owners of the Letter-of-Credit counterparty, or use of Swift / LC proceeds for sanctioned or dual-use mineral cargoes without a suspicious transaction report to the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: VFSC administrative penalties of up to VUV 10,000,000 for the corporate entity, in addition to enforcement action against the licensed registered agent; freezing orders and confiscation of proceeds under the Anti-Money Laundering and Proliferation Financing Act.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Money laundering is a standalone criminal offence punishable by imprisonment of up to 15 years; directors who move or conceal the proceeds with knowledge are prosecuted personally, and foreign directors are exposed to international arrest notices and extradition.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: False beneficial ownership reporting and nominee opacity
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Supplying the VFSC beneficial ownership register with false or incomplete particulars, or structuring shareholding through unregistered nominees to conceal the true principal behind the sulphur mineral ore trade vehicle.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Penalty of up to VUV 1,000,000 per false declaration under the Companies and Trust Review Act 2021; the VFSC registry may strike off the company and refuse restoration; beneficial ownership data is exchanged automatically with OECD jurisdictions on request.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Each director authorising the false filing is jointly and severally liable for the penalty; directors may be disqualified from managing any company in Vanuatu for up to 5 years and imprisoned for up to 12 months.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Annual return default and continued trading while struck off
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Omitting the VFSC annual return and licence fee for successive anniversaries while trade volumes, bank balances, and Letter-of-Credit transactions continue, using the foreign residence of management to avoid local accountability.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Late penalties of up to VUV 250,000; strike-off after one year of default; a struck-off company is dissolved and cannot act as plaintiff in legal proceedings, and its assets are placed under registrar control pending restoration.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who continue trading after strike-off are personally liable for debts incurred after dissolution; the Supreme Court may restrain such directors from leaving Vanuatu pending restoration proceedings and may order civil restitution of diverted assets.
